title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional MONTH-end recapping effective at the open (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2026-10-27 close), the first instance with no capping cut-off in its own month and therefore the family's longest drift window
source: EST: owner-published, every document re-fetched and re-extracted independently this session (2026-09-08). (1) FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated in-session -- byte count and stream count both reproduce what the two sibling lanes recorded). Read at the row level, its section 4.8.6 table gives every Russell US Style index -- Russell 1000 Value/Growth, Top 200 Value/Growth, Midcap Value/Growth, 3000/3000E Value/Growth, Top 500 Value/Growth, 2500 Value/Growth, 2000 Value/Growth -- frequency "Monthly", price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month", trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45". The "Quarterly" / "Last business day in Mar, Jun, Sep and Dec" wording in the same table belongs only to the two FTSE Emerging ex China RIC 22.5/45 rows two lines above. (2) FTSE Russell, "Frequently Asked Questions -- Russell US Equity Indexes" (ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams inflated), whose Regulatory Capping section says verbatim "The review is conducted quarterly (March, June, September, and December)" and whose dated schedule table has FOUR columns keyed to the four quarterly reviews with NO October capping row of any kind. THE DATE IS ARITHMETIC FROM THE GUIDE'S STANDING RULE, NOT READ OFF A PUBLISHED CALENDAR: the last business day of October 2026 is Friday 30 October, so T-1 is Thu 29 October, T-2 is Wed 28 October and T-3 is Tuesday 27 October, with no exchange holiday intervening. NEW EVIDENCE THIS SESSION, WHICH NEITHER SIBLING HAD: the archived FAQ of 2026-02-15 (web.archive.org snapshot 20260215104814, 131,654 bytes, re-inflated in-session) contains NO Regulatory Capping section at all, and its schedule table ends at "Review Effective Date (open of)" with no quarter-end capping rows -- so the FAQ's quarterly prose is not long-standing boilerplate that the guide superseded, it is itself a 2026 addition written between February and July 2026, two months before the guide's August edition added the "Monthly" column. The owner has been actively building out this mechanism's documentation all year, and the newest edit is the monthly one. Filed estimate on four counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published methodology; this lane may not self-confirm; the date is derived from a standing rule rather than read off the owner's dated schedule table, which publishes only the four quarter-end instances; and the owner's two live documents remain in open conflict about the check's frequency. Conditional by construction -- guide section 4.8.4: "If none of the applicable trigger thresholds are breached, no change is implemented as a result of the additional capping check." Canonical file written by this event's own initial research after reading in full the single proposal carrying this id, checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), which read proposals/russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2026-10-30.from-russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2026-12-31.json in full first, then re-fetched every owner document and re-implemented every number rather than inheriting the proposal's readings. Ledger: docs/research/events/russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2026-10-30.md. THE PROPOSAL CALLED THIS THE CLEANEST AVAILABLE TEST OF THE MONTHLY READING AND THAT IS RIGHT, BUT IT CARRIED FORWARD THE DECEMBER LANE'S VERDICT -- "comparable measured breach probability is single-digit" -- AND THAT IS WRONG FOR THIS DATE BY A FACTOR OF ROUGHLY FIVE. The reason is geometry the proposal never computed. October contains NO capping cut-off: the owner's schedule table is keyed to the four quarterly reviews, so the last unconditional reset before this test is the 2026-09-09 style capping cut-off (effective open 2026-09-21), and 2026-09-09 -> 2026-10-27 is 34 trading sessions where December's 12-02 -> 12-28 leg is 17 and September's 09-09 -> 09-25 leg is 12. Guide section 4.8.3 is what fixes that anchor: the test weights "incorporate ... any current capping adjustments, designated to take effect on or before the effective date", so the 09-21 recap is in the weights and the cohort then drifts on prices for 34 sessions. Re-implementing the siblings' method on this session's own five-year bar set (1,253 sessions, 2021-09-09 -> 2026-09-04; 2026-09-08 is an open session and excluded) and modelling the September quarter-end check as the conditional reset it actually is -- it sits INSIDE this window at session 12 -- the joint breach probability is 239/1,219 = 19.61% for IWY and 246/1,219 = 20.18% for IWF. The decomposition is the interesting part: the September test fires in 49/1,219 = 4.02% of windows, and in NONE of those 49 does October then breach as well (0/49), because a cohort that has just run +6.67% in 12 sessions is reset to 45% and has only 22 sessions left to do it again. So essentially all of October's risk lives in the 96% branch where September does nothing. CROSS-CHECKS THAT THE METHOD WAS REBUILT, NOT COPIED: the same code returns 49/1,241 = 3.95% on the 12-session September case (the September lane published 4.02%, the December lane 3.95%), 96/1,236 = 7.77% on the 17-session December case (published 7.76%) and 111/1,236 = 8.98% for IWF (published 8.97%) -- every line within one window. REGIME CAVEAT, STATED BECAUSE IT CUTS THE NUMBER DOWN: the 34-session breach rate is 23.46% over the full five years but 19.72% trailing 3y, 11.75% trailing 2y and 10.09% trailing 12m, so the honest range is about 10-20% rather than a point estimate. THE SECOND FINDING IS WHY THIS INSTANCE IS THE ONE THAT SETTLES THE FREQUENCY CONFLICT. Two non-quarter-end month-end tests have ALREADY run since the guide's monthly wording appeared -- 2026-07-31 (T-3 07-28) and 2026-08-31 (T-3 08-26). Modelled forward from a 45% reset at the 2026-06-17 Q2 capping cut-off, IWY's cohort stood at 46.90% and 46.62% on those two price dates, both comfortably under the 48% trigger. Under the monthly reading both checks ran and correctly did nothing; under the quarterly reading they never happened. THE TWO READINGS PREDICT IDENTICAL OBSERVABLES, so the silence of July and August carries ZERO information about the frequency, and no observation before 2026-10-27 can distinguish them. That model reproduces IWY's observed cohort to 0.72pp (modelled 47.53% vs observed 46.81% on the 2026-08-27 holdings); it overshoots IWF by 2.85pp, which is itself consistent with IWF's cohort having been below the 45% cap in June and therefore never recapped. SCOPE AND SIZE RE-VERIFIED FROM SOURCE, NOT INHERITED: IWY's over-4.8% company cohort (Alphabet's two lines combined per the guide's own rule) is 46.81% -- NVDA 16.21, Alphabet 11.04, AAPL 7.79, MSFT 6.20, AVGO 5.57 -- and IWF's 44.47%, on holdings dated 2026-08-27; IWX 22.79%, IWD 16.40%; IWP, IWS, IWO and IWN have EMPTY cohorts (largest holdings 3.09%, 0.82%, 0.67%, 0.63%) and cannot breach by construction. The single-name leg is dead by a wide margin (NVDA 16.21% against a 24% trigger). A fired recap still moves only about 3pp of IWY's ~$15.94B, roughly $478M, across five of the most liquid names on the tape. IMPACT DELIBERATELY LEFT low DESPITE THE FIVEFOLD PROBABILITY: probability is not impact, and the fire case is unchanged in size. SYMBOLS DELIBERATELY EMPTY: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped this session for rebalanc|reconstitution|russell|capping|index.flow|IWF|IWY -> zero hits in both), and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta. CORRIDOR, AND IT IS THE DENSEST IN THIS FAMILY: 35 tracked events sit within five days, against 29 around the September twin and 14 around the December one. The T-3 price date 2026-10-27 is the session BEFORE fomc-2026-10-28 (high); gdp-q3-2026-advance-2026-10-29 and pce-2026-10-29 (both high) land on the session a triggered recap would trade; eci-q3-2026-10-30 (high), boj-decision-2026-10-30 and chicago-pmi-2026-10-30 share the effective date; midterm-elections-2026-11-03 (high) is four sessions later. The test is struck on the quietest close in a very loud week and would execute straight through it. Kind sector matches the family. The November sibling proposal (russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2026-11-30, filed by the same December lane) is left untouched for its own lane.
